about: Songs, not clips. Each song has versions (one Suno generation each, oldest first), and each version has two takes (Suno makes two per generation). stage is the song's maturity: idea, experiment, shortlist, pre-release, released. pick is the take chosen to carry the song forward (null until chosen). To make this site your own, fork the repository and replace these songs with your own public Suno songs.

stages.about: Lyrics and a style, not yet generated.
Versions being tried; nothing chosen yet.
One take picked to carry the song forward, with your votes in mind.
The picked take downloaded at full quality, with title, lyrics and cover, ready to release.

source: Read from the team's Suno library through Suno's MCP connection by suno.b@SovereignWebsite.dinis, 23 November 2026. Takes are paired by the generation they came from (same creation time). Version labels are short descriptions of each prompt.
